verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-prevention platform, so allow/block lists and velocity limits are a fair question to ask of it. The pack, however, never mentions allow lists, block lists, list entries for emails, cards, devices or IPs, velocity limits, or any API to manage them. The only related item says Decision Center policies can be configured at the Sale checkpoint. That is an adjacent rules feature, not documented list or velocity management, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can maintain allow and block lists — emails, cards, devices, IPs — and velocity limits, managed through the dashboard and programmatically
